2026-10-21:
Chose a UI framework. The first plan was plain Tailwind CSS, but Stef recommended choosing a component library after all. If Exitable eventually wants to use the PoC, they do not have to read and learn all the class names. With a component library, all elements are clear much faster.
There were several options, such as daisyUI, shadcnUI, ui.full.dev and shadcn/vue. I was looking for a combination of both Astro and Vue support. The only one that met this was shadcn/vue.
Shadcn/vue was easy to install. At first I got an error, but this was because I had not installed ESLint. Otherwise everything worked fine, and installing the components went smoothly: within two seconds they were in your app.
